settings.title: Settings
settings.setPasswordDescription: Add a password to sign in with your email as well as GitHub.

terminal.title: Terminal

commands.description: Slash commands expand into prompts. Type / at the start of a message to use one.
commands.name: Name
commands.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, used as /name.

customTools.newVersionTitle: The agent proposes a new version
